name: NURS 4597W
title: Senior Thesis in Nursing
description: This course provides the synthesis of all the elements from prior semesters as students have worked toward their Honors thesis. The overall objective is that the student will write a comprehensive and meritorious thesis using skills of critical and analytical thinking, and scholarly writing.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; at least four credits of NURS 4299; open only to Honors students; open only by instructor consent.
